entries.title: Isaiah 65:1
segments: I am sought by those who asked not for Me; I am found by those who did not seek Me. I said, Behold Me, behold Me, to a nation not calling on My name.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:2
segments: I have spread out My hands all the day to a rebellious people who walk in the way not good, after their own thoughts;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:3
segments: a people who without ceasing provoke Me to anger to My face; who sacrifice in gardens, and burn incense on the bricks;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:4
segments: [a people] who remain among the graves, and sleep in the tombs, who eat swine's flesh, and broth from hateful [things in] their vessels;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:5
segments: who say, Keep to yourself, do not come near me; for I am holier than you. These [are] a smoke in My nose, a fire that burns all the day.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:6
segments: Behold, [it is] written before Me; I will not be silent, except I will repay; yea, I will repay into their bosom

entries.title: Isaiah 65:7
segments: your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, says the LORD, [they] that burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed Me on the hills. And I will measure their former work into their bosom.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:8
segments: So says the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and [one] says, Do not destroy it, for a blessing [is] in it; so I will do to My servants, that I may not destroy them all.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:9
segments: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah one who inherits My mountains; and My elect will inherit it, and My servants will dwell there.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:10
segments: And Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting-place of herds for My people who have sought Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:11
segments: But you [are] those who forsake the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who furnish the drink offering to Fate.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:12
segments: Therefore I will number you to the sword; and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because I called and you did not answer; when I spoke, you did not hear and did evil before My eyes, and chose [that] in which I did not delight.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:13
segments: So the Lord Jehovah says, Behold, My servants will eat, but you will be hungry. Behold, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, My servants will rejoice, but you will be ashamed.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:14
segments: Behold,. My servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will howl because of a breaking of spirit.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:15
segments: And you will leave your name for a curse to My chosen; for the Lord Jehovah will kill you, and call His servants by another name.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:16
segments: [He] who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth. And he who swears in the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from My eyes.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:17
segments: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth. And the things before will not be remembered, nor come to mind.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:18
segments: But be glad and rejoice forever [in that] which I create; for behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:19
segments: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and I will rejoice in My people; and the voice of weeping will no more be heard in her, nor the voice of crying be heard in her.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:20
segments: There will not be an infant, nor an old man that has not filled his days. For the child will die a hundred years old; but the sinner [who is] a hundred years old will be despised.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:21
segments: And they will build houses and live [in them]; and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:22
segments: They will not build, and another live [in them]; they will not plant, and another eat. For like the days of a tree [are] the days of My people, and My elect will long enjoy the work of their hands.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:23
segments: They will not labor in vain, nor bring forth for terror. For they [are] the seed of the beloved of the LORD, and their offspring with them.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:24
segments: And it will be, before they call I will answer; and while they are still speaking, I will hear.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:25
segments: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox; and dust [will be] the food of the snake. They will not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain, says the LORD.
